points: \item Implemented a self-correcting RAG system using LangChain and Mistral 7B, improving answer reliability and documenting failure modes for model reasoning hardening.
\item Built a hybrid retrieval workflow combining dense embeddings and BM25 search, enhancing relevance and coverage of retrieved documents for complex data science challenges.
\item Developed an LLM-as-Judge evaluation pipeline to assess faithfulness and relevance across hundreds of QA examples, ensuring rigorous technical auditing of AI outputs.
\item Introduced batched query extraction using Python and SQL, reducing LLM calls by ~80% per query and enabling efficient generation of ground-truth datasets.
\item Designed an ML-based anomaly detection system for workflows, reducing redundant prompts by 25%, demonstrating capability in identifying logical fallacies in AI reasoning.
\item Containerized and deployed scalable evaluation frameworks using Docker and AWS, ensuring robust pipelines for AI training data generation.
